verses.pali: “Yo, bhikkhave, pathavīdhātuṁ abhinandati, dukkhaṁ so abhinandati.
verses.english: “Mendicants, if you take pleasure in the earth element, you take pleasure in suffering.

verses.pali: Yo dukkhaṁ abhinandati, ‘aparimutto so dukkhasmā’ti vadāmi.
verses.english: If you take pleasure in suffering, you’re not free from suffering, I say.
If you take pleasure in the water element …
If you take pleasure in the fire element …

verses.pali: yo vāyodhātuṁ abhinandati, dukkhaṁ so abhinandati.
verses.english: If you take pleasure in the air element, you take pleasure in suffering.

verses.pali: Yo dukkhaṁ abhinandati, ‘aparimutto so dukkhasmā’ti vadāmi.
verses.english: If you take pleasure in suffering, you’re not free from suffering, I say.

verses.pali: Yo ca kho, bhikkhave, pathavīdhātuṁ nābhinandati, dukkhaṁ so nābhinandati.
verses.english: If you don’t take pleasure in the earth element, you don’t take pleasure in suffering.

verses.pali: Yo dukkhaṁ nābhinandati, ‘parimutto so dukkhasmā’ti vadāmi.
verses.english: If you don’t take pleasure in suffering, you’re free from suffering, I say.
If you don’t take pleasure in the water element …
If you don’t take pleasure in the fire element …

verses.pali: yo vāyodhātuṁ nābhinandati, dukkhaṁ so nābhinandati.
verses.english: If you don’t take pleasure in the air element, you don’t take pleasure in suffering.

verses.pali: Yo dukkhaṁ nābhinandati, ‘parimutto so dukkhasmā’ti vadāmī”ti.
verses.english: If you don’t take pleasure in suffering, you’re free from suffering, I say.”
